posts.body_html:
Again, thank you everyone for the positive feedback, shameless or not!

KE: I think Elaine was more moved by the fact that I'm naming a plant after her. She's not very impressed by Sarracenias anymore (ie. I showed her a blinding white hurricane creek white clone F, and she said something like "I've seen better.") LOL Talk about a tough woman to please, I make her Disa orchid bouquets as little gifts (and they're hard as hell to grow), but she prefers something that I didn't "pick out of the backyard". Ugh, the price you pay when you're married (take notes Naturenuts!!!)

Well, I have quite a few Sarracenias now and this one has became one of my favorite. Due to its size and colors. I mean it's just beautiful!!!

Current tallest pitcher stands at 12 inches!! I just can't stop looking at it. Plus it's got a new growth point producing baby pitchers
